notes: Nova Agent Runtime now supports standard OpenAI-compatible multi-step tool calling
Work agents can list and read project files, open web searches, and navigate URLs
Automatic mode can create or update files inside the selected Work folder
Existing files receive timestamped backups in .nova-work before an agent change
Agent runs stop after 12 tool turns to prevent loops
Providers without tool support automatically fall back to normal Work chat
Workspace Agent access can be set to Read only, Ask before changes, or Automatic in this folder
